text:
Elliot (support): heads up — customer CS-8421 reporting 500s from our hosted inference API (/v1/generate). They started ~10:32 UTC, ~25% of requests returning 5xx. Customer says response body is 'quota service error' and there are no rate-limit headers. Repro steps and sample curl below.

Elliot (support): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hello"}' -- they get 500 and body: {"error":"quota service internal error"} — ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/CS-8421 :eyes:

Maria L.: pinging eng-oncall. any active deploys around 10:20-10:30? also is this new path for quota responses?

deploy-bot: auto-deploy: service/quota-orchestrator @ commit 7a1b2c (deployed 2026-08-02T10:18:03Z) :rocket:

Josh K.: looking. grabbing logs from quota-orch and gateway. quick grep shows a bunch of timeouts to upstream policy-evaluator: 

```
[2026-08-02T10:22:14Z] error: upstream request timed out: connect() to 10.240.11.42:8080 failed (110: Connection timed out), request_id=abc123
[2026-08-02T10:22:15Z] error: quota-orch: dependency timeout evaluating policy, returning 500 to gateway
```

Ana (sre): i see a correlated spike in latency for policy-evaluator pods — CPU at 98% and long GC pauses. requests queued up -> quota-orch hit its internal timeout and propagated 500. gateway is not mapping that to a 429/403, so customers see 5xx.

Maria L.: can we confirm the gateway behavior? should quota timeout map to 4xx (rate/deny) or should it be 5xx? looks like it should be 429/402-ish for quota enforcement, not internal 500s.

Josh K.: confirmed — gateway currently treats any non-200 from quota-orch as 5xx by default. we have an old mapping rule that only converts explicit "quota-denied" payloads to 429. timeouts and upstreamconnect errors fall into 502/504 territory.

Elliot (support): customer is asking for immediate mitigation — they are seeing degraded UX and potential failed billing events. they want a clear ETA.

Ana (sre): immediate mitigation plan: 1) change gateway error-mapping so quota-dependency timeouts return 429 with a short retry-after header (so client SDKs can backoff) 2) enable a temporary circuit-break fallback that returns cached quota decision for known customers for 5m 3) scale up policy-evaluator pods if CPU spike persists. doing (1) and (3) now as hotfix.

Josh K.: applying gateway config change now: `kubectl -n gateway patch configmap gateway-mappings --patch '{"data":{"quotaTimeoutMapping":"429"}}'` — rolling restart gateway pods. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: config-change: gateway-mappings updated by joshk at 2026-08-02T10:25:02Z

Ana (sre): scaling policy-evaluator: `kubectl scale deploy policy-evaluator --replicas=6 -n inference` — monitoring. also increasing the upstream timeout from 2s -> 5s as a stopgap.

Elliot (support): customer notified: "we've applied an emergency mitigation to return 429s for quota timeouts and scaled the evaluator. We expect reduced 5xxs; please let us know if you still see failures. ETA for full fix: 6-8h — we'll follow up with a postmortem."

Josh K.: initial metrics show 5xx rate dropped from 24% -> 3% in the last 2 mins. still seeing a few stragglers from older gateway pods.

Maria L.: great. can someone capture repro steps + logs and add to CS-8421? also we need action items: revert the temporary mapping once evaluator fix is in, add explicit mapping for dependency timeouts -> 429, add health-check for evaluator to avoid CPU GC spikes, and add chaos tests for quota-orch timeouts.

Ana (sre): noted. I'll attach logs and /proc dumps to the ticket. we'll run a full root cause in incidents. planning a postmortem runbook: timeline, why deploy at 10:18 caused CPU regress, why gateway defaulted to 5xx, and customer impact summary.

Elliot (support): thanks team — customer replied :thumbsup: and will validate. tagging for follow-up: @product @security if there are any billing concerns.

Maria L.: adding to the incident board and assigning owners. moving to postmortem state once the runbook is ready. :white_check_mark:
